tagline: A strategic bottling partner of The Coca-Cola Company serving 760 million consumers across 29 countries with proven routes to market and a leading sustainability position
hero_kpi_rationale: Volume is the fundamental driver of growth in the beverage sector, reflecting real demand and market penetration, particularly in emerging markets where per capita consumption is rising and where CCH generates 63% of its volume.

kpis.name: Volume sold
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of beverages sold, in millions of unit cases.
kpis.description: Volume sold increased by 2.8% in 2025, reaching 2,997 million unit cases, driven by emerging markets which represent 63% of total volume.

kpis.name: Price/mix effect
kpis.explanation: Combined impact of price increases and changes in sales composition on revenue growth.
kpis.description: The price/mix effect contributed 5.1% growth in 2025, reflecting pricing management strategies and a more favorable mix, moderating after exceptional increases in 2021-2023.
kpis.signal: Moderate price increases following strong hikes

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total net revenue generated from beverage sales.
kpis.description: Revenue reached 11,605 million euros in 2025, up 8.1% organically, driven by volume (+2.8%) and price/mix effect (+5.1%).

kpis.name: Comparable operating profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit before interest and taxes, a measure of operational profitability.
kpis.description: Comparable operating profit reached 1,356 million euros in 2025, up 11.5%, with a comparable margin of 11.7% versus 11.1% in 2024.

kpis.name: Comparable operating margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue represented by comparable operating profit.
kpis.description: Comparable operating margin improved to 11.7% in 2025 from 11.1% in 2024, reflecting operating leverage and productivity gains.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures / Revenue
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures as a percentage of revenue to maintain and expand capacity.
kpis.description: Capex is expected between 6.5% and 7.5% of revenue, reflecting continued commitment to production capacity and innovation.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of earnings distributed to shareholders as dividends.
kpis.description: The company targets a payout ratio between 40% and 50% of earnings, aligned with a progressive dividend policy and shareholder value return.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after deduction of capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flow reached 700 million euros in 2025, slightly down but maintaining robust cash generation to support capital allocation priorities.

kpis.name: Return on invested capital
kpis.explanation: Measure of capital allocation efficiency, expressed as a percentage of invested capital.
kpis.description: Return on invested capital improved to 19.4% in 2025 from 18.3% in 2024, reflecting better capital allocation and increasing profitability.

kpis.name: Net leverage ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of net debt to comparable EBITDA, a measure of balance sheet strength.
kpis.description: Net leverage ratio stood at 0.7x at end-2025, well below the target range of 1.5x to 2.0x, providing significant financial flexibility.
kpis.signal: Very strong balance sheet well below target

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 103.9176 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.374 Bn GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 39.8% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Volume sold
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of beverages sold, in millions of unit cases.
kpis.description: Volume has grown consistently over 5 years with an average of +3.9% per year, driven primarily by emerging markets which represent 63% of total volume.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total net revenue generated from beverage sales.
kpis.description: Revenue has experienced strong growth over 5 years with an average of +14.7% per year organically, benefiting from both volume growth and a significant price/mix effect.

kpis.name: Comparable operating margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue represented by comparable operating profit.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from 10.1% in 2021 to 11.7% in 2025, demonstrating structural profitability improvement through operating leverage and productivity gains.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention any initiatives related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents. Its technology positioning focuses on bottling operations, customer data management, and digital commerce, with no explicit reference to AI.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning technologies
Focus on basic digital capabilities: data, insights, digital commerce
No reference to AI tools in the five growth pillars
